label: Fejlesztő (bizalmi)
description: Bizalmi profil: megengedő módban fut, minden parancs engedélyezve a deny-listát kivéve (sudo, SSH/AWS/GnuPG kulcs olvasása, force-push, rm -rf). CSAK olyan ügynöknek add, amit ugyanannyira megbízol, mint magadat — üzleti ügynök SOHA nem kapja. Nincs konkrét Solvian-szerep rendelve hozzá; a névsor teljessége miatt tartjuk fenn.
_securityNote: Permissive mode means everything not explicitly denied below is allowed, so this profile's safety rests entirely on the deny-list being exhaustive -- a blocklist, inherently more fragile than a strict allow-list. It also grants broad shell (cat/python3/node/git), so the Read() denies are defense-in-depth only: a Bash-tool read is matched by command prefix, not by the file it touches, and is NOT stopped by a Read() deny (S4.1c recon, fix/dev-profile-deny). Real secret/token isolation between agents requires OS-level (Hard) isolation, deferred pre-scale per Solvian utemterv Sec.6.1. The .vault-key/vault.json denies added in S4.4 are the same Read-only, shell-bypassable residual -- not a hard stop here. A permissive-to-strict-allowlist rework of this profile can be revisited at role-finalization (Solvian C1, post-live).
